name: Hitomezashi
description: Sashiko running stitches along every line of a grid, each line starting on or off the first square, so the stitches lock into a maze of steps.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 9%; width: 82%; top: -4%; height: 8%; border-radius: 99px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); opacity: @calc((floor(2 * ((sin(@y * 12.9898 + 7.1) * 437.585) - floor(sin(@y * 12.9898 + 7.1) * 437.585))) + @x) % 2); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 9%; height: 82%; left: -4%; width: 8%; border-radius: 99px; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); opacity: @calc((floor(2 * ((sin(@x * 78.233 + 3.3) * 437.585) - floor(sin(@x * 78.233 + 3.3) * 437.585))) + @y) % 2); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
